blocks.heading: Summer Catering Focus
blocks.text: Summer Hosting? We’ll Handle the BBQ. Pool parties, lake days, backyard birthdays, graduation blowouts. Whatever’s on your summer calendar, Hutchins BBQ is ready to feed your crew without you lifting a finger. Summer’s too short to stress over cooking. That’s where we come in. Our catering team is here to… READ MORE READ ALL NEWS Built on Faith. Served with Purpose. Hutchins BBQ has been honored multiple times as one of Texas Monthly’s Top 50 BBQ Joints and was voted Best BBQ in DFW for 2025. But our greatest recognition comes from living out the values that built this place — faith, family, and serving others well. Since 1978, we’ve believed great barbecue is more than a meal — it’s an opportunity to bless people, share a table, and serve with purpose.

Trust Hutchins BBQ to cater your next event and satisfy every guest with our delicious BBQ options. Learn More About Catering

blocks.heading: Is the Hutchins BBQ in McKinney and Frisco the original Hutchins BBQ?
blocks.text: Yes. Hutchins BBQ was founded in 1978 by Roy and Delores Hutchins, and our restaurants in McKinney and Frisco are the original Hutchins BBQ locations — owned and operated by the Hutchins family. We’re the team that invented the Texas Twinkie and has been named to Texas Monthly’s Top 50 BBQ list for over a decade.

blocks.heading: Are you the same as Roy Hutchins BBQ in Arlington or Fort Worth?
blocks.text: We share the same barbecue family roots, but it’s a separate business with its own ownership and locations. The Hutchins BBQ you’re looking for in McKinney or Frisco is us — the original Hutchins BBQ. The Roy Hutchins BBQ restaurants operate separately in Arlington, Fort Worth, and Trophy Club. If you’re headed to our McKinney or Frisco pits, you’re in the right place.

blocks.heading: What is a Texas Twinkie?
blocks.text: The Texas Twinkie is our famous bacon-wrapped, brisket-stuffed jalapeño — invented right here at Hutchins BBQ. It’s a guest favorite in the restaurants and a showstopper at catered events .

blocks.heading: Can I order Hutchins BBQ online or have it shipped?
blocks.text: Yes. You can order online for pickup and delivery across the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, and we ship our hickory-smoked brisket and ribs nationwide through Goldbelly — so you can enjoy Hutchins BBQ anywhere.

blocks.heading: Texas BBQ catering packages for every event
blocks.text: From intimate backyard gatherings to 300-guest weddings and corporate events, Hutchins BBQ caters across the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex — McKinney, Frisco, Plano, Allen, Prosper, Dallas, Fort Worth, and Arlington. Choose the package that fits your event:

blocks.heading: Full-Service Catering
blocks.text: On-site setup, serving, and cleanup for weddings, galas, and large events. Sit back and enjoy your event while we handle the BBQ.

testimonials.author: Harshpreet Singh
testimonials.text: Had an amazing experience at Hutchins Barbeque! The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with a classic Texas BBQ vibe. The staff was friendly, helpful, and made the whole experience enjoyable. The food was outstanding. The brisket was perfectly smoked, tender, and full of flavor. The massive beef rib was incredibly juicy and worth every bite. The jalapeño sausage, beans, corn, fried okra, and broccoli salad were all delicious and complemented the meats perfectly. Fresh bread and BBQ sauce completed the meal. Everything tasted fresh, and the quality of the barbecue truly stood out. If you’re looking for authentic Texas-style BBQ with generous portions and excellent service, Hutchins Barbeque is definitely a must-visit. I’ll gladly come back again! Highly recommended!

testimonials.author: Amanda Phillips
testimonials.text: We're from Oklahoma and this was some of the best damn barbecue we've ever had. You can tell from the time you walk in it was going to be good by the sure busyness but they get you through quickly with lots of humor. We came for the Texas Twinkies but they were already sold out at 12:00 on a Saturday afternoon which was a disappointment but the rest of the food we had was amazing. My husband had the brisket & pork sandwich. I got a brisket baked potato and they have all of the fixings and they allow you to get your own condiments. Cheese butter sour cream bacon bits and they have all the fixins pickles and onions for sandwiches, extra bread. Also to our surprise they have free dessert peach cobbler and banana pudding. We got mac and cheese which the kids devoured as well as creamy corn and potato casserole. They also have sauces at the table original, spicy and tangy. We both enjoyed the spicy. The only critique I would have is their dining area is not super kid-friendly very few places to put high chairs but the waitresses were super nice and helpful. Service was 100%

testimonials.author: Min124 Kim
testimonials.text:
If you’re looking for authentic Texas BBQ around Dallas, Hutchins BBQ is definitely a place you shouldn’t miss.

The brisket was incredibly tender, juicy, and packed with smoky flavor. The ribs were perfectly cooked, and the famous Texas Twinkie absolutely lived up to the hype. Their sides—especially the mac & cheese and creamed corn—were just as memorable. To top it all off, the complimentary banana pudding and peach cobbler for dine-in guests were a fantastic bonus.

The restaurant has a lively, casual Texas atmosphere, and although the line can get quite long, it moves efficiently and the staff remain friendly and welcoming.

The only downside is that it’s on the pricier side, but considering the quality and generous portions, it’s easy to see why it’s consistently ranked among the best BBQ spots in the Dallas–Fort Worth area.

testimonials.author: Mario Scroggins
testimonials.text:
I wanted to love this place because so many have recommended it to me. It’s good BBQ, but it’s not great for BBQ. The brisket was moist & tender with a great bark, seasoned to perfection outside. However, I was expecting more flavor throughout the meat and did not receive that.
The chicken was good but I personally didn’t care for the rub. I’m not holding that against them. It was still good. The Mac & Cheese was simply basic Mac. The ribs were tender but again, they lacked flavor.
The Texas Twinkie was amazing. It’s everything…..I would like it if the cream cheese filling was seasoned but all and all it was great.

This place looks and has the ambience of a classic BBQ joint but for the premiere BBQ features (Brisket & Ribs), I was expecting a bit more flavor.
Again, I was just good not great but that’s just my preference. This place has a lot of respect for what they do and I’m sure it’s well deserved.

testimonials.author: Marco Luzano
testimonials.text:
Hutchins BBQ absolutely delivered! The brisket was the star—tender, juicy, and packed with smoky flavor, with an incredible bark and a perfect smoke ring. The ribs and sausage were excellent too, and the chicken had a great smoky char.

The sides definitely held their own. The mac & cheese was rich and creamy, the potato salad was on point, and the creamed corn was seriously addictive.

If you’re looking for authentic Texas BBQ with generous portions and meats that speak for themselves, Hutchins BBQ is a must-try. Come hungry—you’re going to want a little bit of everything!

5/5 ⭐️ — Great BBQ and definitely worth the visit!
